lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R2-001 (CAM-388 review round 2) fixed the reviewer's CRITICAL finding: findClosingQuoteIndex (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts) had the US-R1-001 POSIX single-quote escape-continuation guard ('\'') but no equivalent guard for a DOUBLE-quoted span's backslash-escaped quote (\"), so a genuine live comparison inside a double-quoted -c wrapper was silently excused: bash -c "echo \"hi\"; test $(wc -l < f) -eq 3" and sh -c "test \"$X\" -eq 3" both resolved their closing quote at the FIRST escaped \", truncating the unwrapped payload to 'echo \\' / 'test \\' and discarding the segment carrying the real -eq comparison -- verified false-negative (flag=false) against both reviewer-cited commands before the fix, flag=true after. Per POSIX Shell Command Language 2.2.3, backslash retains its escaping meaning inside double quotes only before $ ` " \ <newline>, so \" does not terminate a double-quoted span; single quotes have NO backslash-escape meaning at all (confirmed via the GNU Bash manual citation already recorded for US-R1-001), so the new guard is scoped to quoteChar === '"' only via a backslash-run-parity check (odd run of backslashes immediately preceding a candidate closing quote = escaped, skip past and keep searching; even run = genuine close, e.g. \\" still closes). Two new fixture rows added to test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt reproducing the reviewer's exact two named commands (both 'flag', i.e. correctly detected as live comparisons). Docstrings for findClosingQuoteIndex and stripQuotedSpans updated to describe the double-quote backslash-parity guard alongside the existing single-quote continuation guard. A DIFFERENT reviewer finding (US-R2-002, WARNING, priority 2) was queued in the same review round about LIVE_DERIVATION_RE being evaluated against a stripped string that already destroyed a non--c quoted span's derivation token -- that finding was NOT touched by this story (out of scope, priority 2, will be its own story) and remains queued in prd.json with passes:false. Verified by bun test (58/58 pass in prd-oracle-lint.test.ts, full suite 5230/5230 pass) and full bun run check:all spine green (test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps). No external library touched (pure internal regex/TS logic); Step 5.5 recorded as no_external_lib_touched. scripts/cam/prd.json is not edited by this story per the 'supervisor is sole writer of passes' rule.
